constant_acceleration_definition: a_t=(v_t-v_{t-1})/dt; p_hat(t+h)=p_t+v_t*tau+0.5*a_t*tau^2. No acceleration clipping or outcome-based tuning is used.
common_support_rule: A row is evaluated only when both the immediately previous current snapshot and the target future snapshot are available in the same held-out run, so all three projection modes use identical rows.
geometry_rule: Projected and actual future geometric graphs both use the current snapshot radius, matching the kinematic feature construction. Physical-radio frag_at_horizon is reported only as a proxy endpoint and is not treated as geometric ground truth.
interpretation: Post-review motion-assumption sensitivity. It tests whether constant acceleration materially improves geometric/topological projection over constant velocity; it does not claim a new forecasting model.
completion_rule: All three modes must cover all six horizons for all 20 revision seeds on common support.
